  WHEN id = 30013 THEN '/collections/jeux-collectifs.jpg'
  WHEN id = 30014 THEN '/collections/activites-manuelles.jpg'
  WHEN id = 30015 THEN '/collections/environnement-nature.jpg'
  WHEN id = 30016 THEN '/collections/leadership-citoyennete.jpg'
  WHEN id = 30011 THEN '/collections/activites-ete.jpg'
  WHEN id = 30012 THEN '/collections/formation-bafa.jpg'
  WHEN id = 2 THEN '/collections/collection-proteger.jpg'
END WHERE id IN (30013, 30014, 30015, 30016, 30011, 30012, 2);
